summary: Iteration 16 — Verified 3 new TUSAŞ features: (1) Project filter dropdown in TopBar, (2) Yetenek Programları page, (3) Güvenlik Soruşturması page. Backend: 12/12 new pytest cases pass. All KPI numbers match the spec exactly (700/627/352/301, 3000/289/223, KAAN=467). Frontend: Confirmed via Playwright + screenshots — project dropdown shows all 8 expected options (KAAN, HURJET, ANKA, AKSUNGUR, GOKBEY, A400M Yapısallar, Uzay Sistemleri, Genel), selecting KAAN reduces headcount from 2020 → 467, Yetenek Programları page shows 6 program breakdown (SKY Stajyer, MGP, LIFT UP, Kadin Mentorluk, LIFT UP+, SKY int) with Excel export, Güvenlik Soruşturması page shows all 7 funnel stages (Başvuru→Online Değerlendirme→İK Mülakatı→Teknik Mülakat→Güvenlik Soruşturması→Teklif→İşe Başlama) with department table + Excel export + duration distribution. Sidebar menu items 'Yetenek Programları' & 'Güvenlik Soruşturması' correctly placed under İşe Alım. yapikredi tenant does NOT show project selector (banking has no PROJECTS config) — confirmed.

issues: Program name shown as 'Kadin Mentorluk' (Latin i) instead of 'Kadın Mentorluk' (Turkish ı) — check seed data / Excel source. Backend returns it as 'Kadin Mentorluk' consistently.

action_items: OPTIONAL/MINOR: Route /admin/rapor/tusas/overview returns a blank page (only TopBar + sidebar render). Only /admin/rapor/tusas/ (without trailing /overview) maps to the Genel Bakış component. Navigation via sidebar works fine, but if any deep link uses /overview it will 404-render. Consider adding a route alias or redirect from /overview → / in App.js. NOT a regression from this iteration.
OPTIONAL: 'Kadın Mentorluk' program name is stored as 'Kadin Mentorluk' (missing Turkish ı) — verify against source Excel; may be an ETL normalization issue.
critical_code_review_comments: get_filtered() cleanly adds project param at Mongo query level — no code duplication, applied uniformly across ~25 endpoints.

Overview page URL/route mismatch: direct navigation to /admin/rapor/tusas/overview renders blank because there is no /overview child route (root path is the overview). Not caused by this iteration but worth documenting.
server.py now 4132 lines — continues to grow. Consider splitting into route modules (previous iter also flagged this).
Both new endpoints correctly use projection {'_id': 0} — no ObjectId leaks.

guvenlik-sorusturmasi endpoint accepts project param but does NOT actually filter by project (query dict only adds tenant/department/hrbp). If project filtering is required for recruitment data, add `if project: query['project'] = project` around line 4007.
test_credentials: admin@plenalitik.com / Plena2025! — works. Tenant slugs: tusas, yapikredi.
seed_data_creation: None — collections talent_programs (700 records) and recruitment (3000 records) already seeded for tusas.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_tusas_new_features.py is the regression suite for the project filter, /dashboard/yetenek-programlari and /dashboard/guvenlik-sorusturmasi endpoints. It uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env if the env var is not exported to the shell. Data-testid for project selector: [data-testid='project-selector']. Frontend Overview route is /admin/rapor/tusas/ (no /overview suffix) — use sidebar 'Genel Bakış' link to reach it. Programs and stages should match: 6 talent programs & 7 recruitment funnel stages exactly.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all 3 features work as spec'd. Only cosmetic observation: 'Kadin Mentorluk' vs 'Kadın Mentorluk' Turkish diacritics missing on one program name (source data issue).
